summary.result: Based on the results of the model evaluation study, it is concluded that ADAPT model can be used to design water table management systems.
summary.background: The effects of drainage system on evapotranspiration and drainage flows are studied.
summary.method: A water table management model, ADATP (Agricultural Drainage and Pesticide Transport), which was developed by combining the GLEAMS and the subsurface drainage part of the DRAINMOD model with several modifications, was evaluated and used to predict hydrologic components.
